assessment.assessment_title: RHEL 9 must disable the ability of systemd to spawn an interactive boot process.
assessment.evidence_guidance: Retain the completed source OCIL evidence and reviewer notes.
assessment.procedure:
Manual alternative preserved from the original OCIL check. Follow the source procedure; this Assessment does not execute OCIL.

Verify that GRUB 2 is configured to disable interactive boot.

Check that the current GRUB 2 configuration disables the ability of systemd to spawn an interactive boot process with the following command:

$ sudo grubby --info=ALL | grep args | grep 'systemd.confirm_spawn'

If any output is returned, this is a finding.
